name: Baccarat Hotel New York City
insider_take: This crystal palace in Midtown Manhattan is where French luxury meets Fifth Avenue glamour, creating an ultra-exclusive retreat above the city's most coveted shopping district.
whats_special: The hotel showcases over 250 pieces of custom Baccarat crystal throughout its interiors, including a stunning 15-foot crystal chandelier in the lobby. Located directly across from MoMA, this architectural gem was designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill and features floor-to-ceiling windows offering spectacular Central Park views from upper floors.
pro_tip: Book a spa treatment at La Mer Spa - it's one of only three La Mer spas worldwide and offers exclusive treatments using the brand's coveted skincare products.
dont_miss: Cocktails at Bar at Baccarat, where every glass is made from Baccarat crystal, and dinner at Chevalier, the hotel's French brasserie featuring cuisine by three-Michelin-starred chef Shea Gallante. The hotel's location puts you steps from Tiffany & Co.'s flagship store and the luxury boutiques of Fifth Avenue.
pros: Iconic Baccarat crystal design elements throughout property
Prime Midtown Manhattan location near Central Park
Exceptional fine dining at Chevalier restaurant
cons: Limited hotel amenities compared to larger properties
